terms.comment: A triad (Tert.), and the Trinity (Lewis & Short); Sāncta Trīnitās, the Holy Trinity. In the Orthodox Church Pentecost is also the feast of the Holy Trinity; in the West Trinity Sunday is the Sunday after it.

phrases.latin: Chrīstum rogēmus et Patrem, Chrīstī Patrisque Spīritum: ūnum potēns per omnia fovē precantēs, Trīnitās
phrases.english: Let us pray to Christ and the Father, and the Spirit of Christ and the Father: one and almighty, keep us who pray, O Trinity
Lord, one God, God the Trinity
